input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only IP allocation is one-directional: TrueLink retains all ownership rights in the Interface (§ 2(d)) and we receive a non-exclusive, use-only licence that "shall last until this Agreement is terminated" (§ 2(c)). Nothing addresses the programming customisation work product we pay for under the Support Services (§ 4; Exhibit "B"), which is only treated as Client Proprietary Information for confidentiality purposes (§ 10(c)) - that is not an ownership or licence right. So we have no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence, and no right to modify or sublicense the deliverables, and the fallback fails on its material terms. We have targeted the fallback: TrueLink keeps ownership of the Interface and its tools and know-how, and a new § 2(e) gives us the licence to the results of the Support Services. Two points are noted but not flagged: there is no walk-away trigger, as § 8(d) licenses (rather than assigns) narrowly defined aged raw Credit Data to TrueLink on a non-exclusive basis excluding Client Proprietary Information, and no joint ownership is created anywhere.

proposal.summary: Add § 2(e) granting Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the results of the Support Services, leaving TrueLink's ownership of the Interface intact.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2 allocates ownership of the Interface to TrueLink but says nothing about the programming work product we pay for under the Support Services. We have added a new 2(e) giving us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense that work product in our business, while TrueLink keeps ownership of the Interface and its underlying tools and know-how - our fallback position.

ops.text: e. Results of Support Services. Notwithstanding section 2(d), TrueLink hereby grants to Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense all results of the Support Services and any other work product prepared for Client hereunder in Client's business.
